editorial.blurb: CM Chicken Kimball delivers authentic Korean fried chicken with genuine hospitality and crispy, flavorful results that taste fresh from Seoul.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive well before 8:30pm when the kitchen stops taking orders (30 minutes before posted closing time); the owner is generous about accommodating diners and will even seat you close to closing if you arrive in time.
signatureDishes: Wings with white cream and onions
